2123039494974894198.en_summary: Credo (CRDO) and Marvell (MRVL) settle patent dispute over AEC technology. CRDO up 4.1% and MRVL up 2.0% pre-market.
2123039494974894198.zh_summary: Credo（CRDO）與Marvell（MRVL）就AEC技術專利糾紛達成和解。CRDO盤前上漲4.1%，MRVL上漲2.0%。

2123039024998957320.en_summary: Nvidia (NVDA) up 3.0% pre-market. The Bank of Nvidia is becoming more disciplined and selective, according to BBG.
2123039024998957320.zh_summary: Nvidia（NVDA）盤前上漲3.0%。據BBG報導，Nvidia的銀行業務正變得更加紀律嚴明和有選擇性。

2123038972821770496.en_summary: (Replying to @Newsurgeey) Opening will be sloppy. Questions where NVDA opens and impact on the whole SQ process. Most likely path is a mirror opposite of yesterday.
2123038972821770496.zh_summary: （回覆@Newsurgeey）開盤將會混亂。質疑NVDA開盤位置及其對整個SQ過程的影響。最可能的路徑是昨日的鏡像相反。

2123038955146752419.en_summary: Nvidia (NVDA) up 3.0% pre-market. Nvidia chair dismisses idea of rehiring Huang and vows fast search for new CEO.
2123038955146752419.zh_summary: Nvidia（NVDA）盤前上漲3.0%。Nvidia主席駁回重新聘用黃仁勳的想法，並誓言快速尋找新CEO。

2123038901589991618.en_summary: Nvidia (NVDA) up 3.0% pre-market. Nvidia's numbers impress but investors fret over CEO succession.
2123038901589991618.zh_summary: Nvidia（NVDA）盤前上漲3.0%。Nvidia業績令人印象深刻，但投資者擔心CEO繼任問題。
